summary: Bearer is Resistant to the next source that would wound, kill, apply a State or cause another negative effect; not their own effects.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: All effects of the next source that would inflict a wound, death, a State, or other negative effect. Does not trigger against effects cast by the bearer.

restrictions.note: Does not trigger against effects cast by the bearer.

termination.note: Resistant to the next source only. The general Enchantment rules (mechanics-and-definitions, Enchantments 5) name Blessing Against Harm as an Enchantment with a definite number of uses, removed when its last use is expended even if ineffective.

clarifications.text: Covers everything from the source: wounds, death, States and any other negative effect.
Does not trigger against effects cast by the bearer themselves.
